name: Terminal Damage
author: nyannoying
description: Beta. A broken car is no longer taken away: it loses power or rolls out, you pull over (retire after 10 s) or drive into your box and the crew pushes it in. Needs the game's UDP telemetry.

options.label: Debug: performance counters
options.description: Measure this addon's private-hook work and log totals every 10 seconds. Original game calls and GPU/asset cost are excluded. Enable only while investigating FPS drops.

options.label: Retirement radio voice
options.description: Play the engineer's stop-car reply when selecting Retire in the radio menu. Off keeps Retire usable without the reply. Applies after a game restart.

options.label: Radio menu retirement
options.description: Retire in the radio menu requests retirement: pull over and stop for 10 s, or drive into your box. A second selection changes nothing. Requires Keep control. Restart after enabling.

options.label: Garage crew assets in the race
options.description: The race also loads the garage crew scenes, so your crew can push a broken car in. Needs a game restart.

options.label: Keep control after terminal damage
options.description: After terminal damage you keep your car. It does not count as a stopped car for safety car or red flag.

options.label: UDP telemetry port
options.description: Port the mod listens on. Set the same port in the game. If another app (SimHub etc.) uses 20777, pick another one and forward to it. Needs a game restart.

options.label: Power with a broken turbo/ERS part
options.description: Throttle left when MGU-K, MGU-H, battery, turbo or CE has failed. A failed engine (ICE) or gearbox always gives no drive.

options.label: Engine sound off after a failure
options.description: A failed engine (ICE) plays the engine stop sound at once, terminal crash damage after 3 to 6 s, a retiring car standing still after 6 s; then it stays silent.

options.label: Retire hotkey
options.description: Ctrl+Shift + key: retire without breaking anything. Pull over and stand still 10 s, or drive into your box. Press again to cancel.

options.label: Retire hotkey (with Ctrl+Shift)
options.description: F key pressed together with Ctrl+Shift to retire. Pick one no other mod uses.

options.label: Retire in the pause menu: pull over first
options.description: On track, Retire in the pause menu does not end your race at once: pull over and stand still 10 s, or drive into your box.

options.label: Retire in the pit box
options.description: With keep control: when you bring your broken car into your pit box, it retires there, as with Retire in the pause menu.

options.label: Experimental: clear retirement pit box
options.description: Hides tyre-stop equipment during a race retirement approach. Preserves the shared box while your teammate is pitting. Garage push crew remains visible.

options.label: Crew pushes the car into the garage
options.description: With "Retire in the pit box": your crew pushes the broken car into the garage, then it retires. Retires in the box after 15 s if no push comes.

options.label: Garage crew in the race
options.description: Spawns your garage crew in the race once your broken car stands in its pit box. Load a practice session first in the same game start. Needs "Garage crew assets in the race" and a game restart.

options.label: Debug: garage crew diagnostics
options.description: Logs garage crew and asset details to swofty/loader.log. Needs a game restart.

options.label: Debug: log telemetry
options.description: Writes speed, rpm, gear and position of your car to swofty/loader.log.

options.label: Debug: hotkey triggers a failure
options.description: Ctrl+Shift + the chosen F key breaks the chosen part of your car. Ctrl+Shift+F9 then cycles the throttle cap (0 %, 30 %, automatic).

options.label: Debug: hotkey (with Ctrl+Shift)
options.description: F key pressed together with Ctrl+Shift. Pick one no other mod uses.

options.label: Debug: failing part
options.description: Part to break: 0 ICE, 1 MGU-K, 2 MGU-H, 3 ES, 4 TC, 5 CE, 6 gearbox. Order taken from the AI failure code.
